Manifest.Name: 环带交易所 (Orbit Exchange)
Manifest.Author: MengUkal
Manifest.Description: 通过暗网接入"环带交易所"：8 只空间站股票、像素K线、买卖持仓，行情与报纸事件真实联动——读报、抓传闻、低买高卖。快捷键默认 F8，需先在暗网购买"交易所接入"。Access the Orbit Exchange from the darknet: 8 station stocks with pixel charts. Prices react to newspaper events — read the news, front-run the rumors, buy low, sell high. Hotkey F8 by default.
